newsitem.title: UK: London tea auction sees fairly good demand.
newsitem.headline: London tea auction sees fairly good demand.

text.p: Fairly good demand was reported at the latest London auction by the Tea Brokers' Association of London.
Among landeds, Assams met good competition at fully firm to occasionally dearer rates.

Brightest East Africans were a strong feature and prices were often several pence higher. However, lighter liqouring invoices and most mediums showed an easier tendency with prices falling 2 to 3 pence. Offshore met good inquiry at above last levels.
